annotations.title: Add a note to a candidate

description: WRITE: add a note to a candidate's profile, visible to the team. Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/candidates/{candidate_id}/notes.
name: recruitee_add_candidate_note
title: Add a note to a candidate

description: WRITE: add one or more tags to a candidate (existing tags are reused by name; new names create new tags). Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/candidates/{candidate_id}/tags.

tags.description: Tag names to add, e.g. ["Python developer"].

name: recruitee_add_candidate_tags
title: Tag a candidate

annotations.title: Add a candidate to a job

description: WRITE: put an existing candidate on a job (or talent pool) — creates a placement in the pipeline's first stage. Pass exactly one of offer_id or talent_pool_id. Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/placements.
name: recruitee_assign_candidate_to_offer
title: Add a candidate to a job

description: WRITE: add a candidate manually (as if a recruiter added them in the app — no auto-confirmation email is sent), optionally assigning them straight to one or more jobs in the job's default stage. Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/candidates.

offer_ids.description: Jobs/talent pools to assign the candidate to (default stage).

remote_cv_url.description: Public URL of the CV file for Recruitee to fetch.

name: recruitee_create_candidate
title: Create a candidate

description: WRITE: create a recruiting task, optionally about a candidate, assigned to team members (admin ids from recruitee_list_team_members), with an optional due date. Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/tasks.

timezone.description: Timezone of the due date, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam.

name: recruitee_create_task
title: Create a task

description: Fetch one candidate's full profile: contact details, sources, tags, cover letter, CV URL, custom fields, ratings, and `placements` — one per job they are on, each with its placement id and current stage. The placement id is what recruitee_move_candidate_stage needs. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/candidates/{id}.
name: recruitee_get_candidate
title: Get one candidate

description: Fetch the Recruitee user the API token belongs to — name, email, role, role abilities and company id. A cheap way to confirm the token and company id are right. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/admin.
name: recruitee_get_current_user
title: Get the current user

description: Fetch one job or talent pool by id with its full details: description, requirements, location, salary, employment type, candidate counters and pipeline_template_id. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/offers/{id}.
name: recruitee_get_offer
title: Get one job

description: Fetch a pipeline template with its ordered stages (id, name, group, category). A job's `pipeline_template_id` (from recruitee_list_offers / recruitee_get_offer) names its pipeline; the stage ids here are what recruitee_move_candidate_stage takes. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/pipeline_templates/{id}.
name: recruitee_get_pipeline_template
title: Get a hiring pipeline

description: List the notes on a candidate's profile, with replies, author admin_id and visibility. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/candidates/{candidate_id}/notes.
name: recruitee_list_candidate_notes
title: List a candidate's notes

description: List candidates, newest first, optionally filtered by job, search, qualification, ids or creation date. Default 25 per page. detail auto returns whole records where they fit; if one record or page metadata is too large, explicitly marked summaries preserve candidate ids and omit other fields/references. detail full requires whole records; summary always returns summaries. Pages can be smaller than limit: continue with pagination.next_offset as offset and the same filters; null means finished. Do not advance by limit. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/candidates.

created_after.description: Only candidates created after this date (ISO 8601).

detail.description: Default auto: full records, with an explicitly marked summary fallback for oversized records/metadata. full refuses a page that cannot fit; summary returns only bounded identity fields.

limit.description: Candidates fetched per page (default 25, max 1000); the returned page can be smaller to fit the output budget.

offer_id.description: Only candidates on this job/talent pool.

query.description: Search by candidate name or job.

name: recruitee_list_candidates
title: List candidates

description: List the company's departments with their ids and job counts. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/departments.
name: recruitee_list_departments
title: List departments

description: List the company's configured disqualification reasons (id, name, position). Useful for reading why candidates were disqualified. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/disqualify_reasons.
name: recruitee_list_disqualify_reasons
title: List disqualify reasons

description: List interview results — evaluations (rating + note) and questionnaire scorecards — optionally for one candidate or by selected reviewers. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/interview/results.

admin_ids.description: Only results by these admin ids.

page.description: Page number; only used together with limit.

name: recruitee_list_evaluations
title: List evaluations

description: List scheduled interview events (candidate_id, offer_id, stage_id, start time, duration, location, attendees). Defaults to upcoming events for the whole company; narrow by candidate, date range or interviewer. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/interview/events.

admin_ids.description: Only events assigned to these admin ids.

page.description: Page number; only used together with limit.

timezone.description: Timezone for the date range, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam.

name: recruitee_list_interview_events
title: List interviews

description: List the company's jobs (Recruitee calls them offers) with id, title, status, slug, department_id, recruiter_id, hiring_manager_id and pipeline_template_id. Filter by status, department, location, recruiter, hiring manager, tag and more; add heavy fields with `include` (e.g. counters for candidate counts, description, salary, location_ids). Paginated with limit + page (default 1000 per page); `meta.total_count` gives the total. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/offers.

categories.description: Only these job categories, e.g. information_technology.

employment_types.description: Only these employment types, e.g. fulltime.

hiring_manager_ids.description: Only jobs with these hiring managers (admin ids).

lang_codes.description: Only jobs in these languages, e.g. en.

recruiter_ids.description: Only jobs with these recruiters (admin ids).

tag_ids.description: Only jobs with these job tags.

name: recruitee_list_offers
title: List jobs

description: List the company's candidate tags with ids and usage counts. Tag ids are used in recruitee_search_candidates filters. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/tags.
name: recruitee_list_tags
title: List candidate tags

description: List recruiting tasks (title, description, due date, completed, candidate_id). With candidate_id, lists that candidate's tasks (Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/candidates/{candidate_id}/tasks — only `status` applies). Otherwise lists company tasks with scope, assignee, sorting and paging (Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/tasks).

admin_ids.description: Only tasks assigned to these admin ids (company list only).

name: recruitee_list_tasks
title: List tasks

description: List the company's team members (memberships): admin_id, role, whether they are a recruiter or hiring manager, and the jobs they can access. Use admin_id values for task assignees and filters. User names/emails are in the `references` array. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/memberships.

role_id.description: Only members with this role id.

name: recruitee_list_team_members
title: List team members

annotations.title: Move a candidate to another stage

description: WRITE: move a candidate to another stage of a job's pipeline. Takes the PLACEMENT id (from recruitee_get_candidate → placements[].id, one per job) and the destination stage id (from recruitee_get_pipeline_template). Moving to a 'hired' stage also requires work_location_id. Stage automations configured in Recruitee may run. Undo by moving back. Recruitee: PATCH /c/{company_id}/placements/{id}/change_stage.

placement_id.description: The placement id (candidate-on-job), not the candidate id.

work_location_id.description: Location id — required by Recruitee when the destination is a hired stage.

name: recruitee_move_candidate_stage
title: Move a candidate to another stage

description: Search the company's candidates with Recruitee's candidate search (the same engine as the app's filters). `query` is a free-text search across name, emails, phones, tags, sources, job assignments, current stage, cover letter and CV content. `filters` accepts Recruitee filter objects verbatim, e.g. {"field":"created_at","gte":1548975600} (Unix seconds), {"field":"has_cv","eq":true}, {"filter":"tags","id":{"in":[12]}}, {"filter":"stages","name":{"in":["Phone interview"]}}. Returns `hits` (with each candidate's placements: job + current stage) and `total`. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/search/new/candidates.

filters.description: Additional Recruitee search filter objects, sent as filters_json.

sort_by.description: Sort key with _asc or _desc suffix, e.g. created_at_desc (default), relevance_desc, candidate_name_asc, candidate_rating_desc, candidate_stage_name_asc.

name: recruitee_search_candidates
title: Search candidates

description: WRITE: update a candidate's name or contact details. Only the fields you pass change; list fields (emails, phones, links) REPLACE the existing list, so pass the full list you want. Recruitee: PATCH /c/{company_id}/candidates/{id}.

emails.description: Full replacement list of email addresses.

links.description: Full replacement list of other links.

phones.description: Full replacement list of phone numbers.

social_links.description: Full replacement list of social profile URLs.

name: recruitee_update_candidate
title: Update a candidate
